findings.body: The `before` snapshot comes from the already-refactored package, so comparing it with another run only proves stability when adding a module. A rendering change introduced by this branch would appear in both snapshots and pass. Existing coverage does not complete this proof: `tests/test_setup.py:126` also compares consecutive runs, while `tests/test_trim_skills.py:27` pins only selected skill contents. Add an end-to-end compatibility test against independently captured pre-change output, checking the complete shipped path set and bytes, including conditional files and git hook shims.
findings.title: Not done: byte-for-byte compatibility test for Done-when 3
